// The On Hand / Committed / Not Avail / Allocated / Available block, rendered
// identically for a kit line and for each of its alternatives. A non-inventory
// part has no stock at all, so it gets one spanning note rather than five dashes
// pretending to be measurements.
//
// Two figures are called out because they explain an otherwise mute zero:
//   * Not Available > 0  — the stock exists but is in a QC-hold style location.
//   * Allocated > On Hand — over-promised. This is what drives Available
//     negative, and (when consolidated) what lets one group's shortfall eat
//     into another group's real stock.
function _availCells(a, isInv) {
    if (!isInv) {
        return '<td class="num">—</td><td class="num">—</td><td class="num">—</td>' +
               '<td class="num">—</td><td class="num"><span class="noninv">Non-Inv</span></td>';
    }

        na = a ? a.notavail : 0, al = a ? a.allocated : 0, av = a ? a.available : 0;

        ? '<span class="avl-flag" title="' + esc(fmtQty(na) + ' sits in a location that is not counted as ' +
            'available (QC hold, quarantine and the like) — physically present but unusable.') + '">' +
            fmtQty(na) + '</span>'
        : fmtQty(na);
    var alCell = (al > oh)
        ? '<span class="avl-flag" title="' + esc('Over-allocated: ' + fmtQty(al) + ' of open order demand ' +
            'against only ' + fmtQty(oh) + ' on hand, a shortfall of ' + fmtQty(al - oh) + '. Available for ' +
            'Sale is negative here and is floored to zero; consolidating groups lets this shortfall reduce ' +
            'the real stock held in another group.') + '">' + fmtQty(al) + '</span>'
        : fmtQty(al);
    return '<td class="num">' + fmtQty(oh) + '</td>' +
           '<td class="num">' + fmtQty(cm) + '</td>' +

           '<td class="num">' + alCell + '</td>' +
           '<td class="num">' + fmtQty(av) + '</td>';

// One row per kit line, plus (collapsed under a ▸) one row per selectable
// alternative. Alternatives are priced at the SAME qty/kit as the line they
// replace — Fishbowl swaps the product, not the quantity.
function _drillRows(kitId, lgId) {
    var lines = (_linesByKit[kitId] || []).slice().sort(function (a, b) {
        return (a.sortorder - b.sortorder) || (a.kititemid - b.kititemid);
    });
    var constraintSet = _constraintByKey[kitId + '|' + lgId] || new Set();
    if (!lines.length) {
        return '<tr><td colspan="10" style="color:var(--c-tertiary); padding:14px; text-align:center;">' +
               'This kit has no component lines.</td></tr>';
    }
    var out = '';
    lines.forEach(function (l) {
        var isOptional = LINE_OPTIONAL.indexOf(l.linetypeid) !== -1;
        var inv = _lineIsInventory(l);
        var qpk = _lineQtyPerKit(l);
        var a = _availMap[l.partid + '|' + lgId] || null;
        var counts = _lineConstrains(l, true);   // the headline counts every line
        var kitsCell;
        if (!inv) kitsCell = '—';
        else if (!(qpk > 0)) kitsCell = '∞';
        else kitsCell = fmtQty(Math.floor((a ? a.available : 0) / qpk));

        // Qty / Kit renders in the PART's stocking UOM, because On Hand,
        // Available and Kits all come from inventory, which is held in the part
        // base UOM. Showing the authored figure here would silently mix two unit
        // systems in adjacent columns — exactly the .jrxml's bug made visible.
        var rowUom = (l.partuom || l.kituom || '');
        var mixedUom = l.kituom && l.partuom && l.kituom !== l.partuom;
        var qpkCell = inv || l.partid
            ? fmtQty(qpk) +
              (mixedUom
                ? ' <span class="uom-orig" title="' + esc('Kit line is authored as ' + fmtQty(l.kitqty) + ' ' +
                    l.kituom + '; converted to ' + l.partuom + ' (x' + fmtQty(l.multiply) + ' / ' +
                    fmtQty(l.factor) + ') because inventory is held in ' + l.partuom + '.') + '">(' +
                    fmtQty(l.kitqty) + ' ' + esc(l.kituom) + ')</span>'
                : '') +
              (!l.convok
                ? ' <span class="uom-bad" title="' + esc('No UOM conversion exists from ' + (l.kituom || '?') +
                    ' to ' + (l.partuom || '?') + ', so 1:1 was assumed. This quantity — and the Kits figure ' +
                    'derived from it — is unreliable until the conversion is set up in Fishbowl.') + '">*</span>'
                : '')
            : fmtQty(l.kitqty);

        var isConstraint = counts && constraintSet.has(l.partid);
        var alts = (_optionsByLine[l.kititemid] || []).filter(function (o) {
            return o.partid && o.partid !== l.partid;
        });
        var canExpand = alts.length > 0;
        // Start a choice OPEN when the default is not the best pick: that is
        // precisely the case the alternatives exist to reveal, and leaving it
        // folded hides the answer behind a chevron nobody knows to click.
        var startOpen = canExpand && qpk > 0 &&
            ((_lineBest(l, lgId, false).choice || {}).partid !== l.partid);
        // Where the line offers a choice, every option carries the KIT total it
        // would produce alongside its own capacity — the part supporting 323 is
        // not the same claim as the kit reaching 69.
        var bestPart = canExpand ? (_lineBest(l, lgId, false).choice || {}).partid : null;
        // `choice` must be the real object — _choiceKits reads parttype, and an
        // alternative can be non-inventory just as a line can.
        function _ifCell(choice, ownKits) {
            // A line consuming nothing is unbounded whichever option is picked,
            // so "best" and a kit total would be decoration with no information.
            if (!canExpand || !(qpk > 0)) return ownKits;
            var tot = _kitTotalIfChosen(kitId, lgId, l, choice);
            var win = (choice.partid === bestPart)
                ? ' <span class="best-pick" title="Best-stocked choice on this line.">best</span>' : '';
            return ownKits + '<span class="kit-if" title="What this kit totals if this option is the one selected.">' +
                   ' → kit ' + (tot == null ? '—' : fmtQty(tot)) + '</span>' + win;
        }
        var toggle = canExpand
            ? '<span class="alt-toggle' + (startOpen ? ' open' : '') + '" onclick="_toggleAlts(this,' + l.kititemid + ')" title="Show the selectable alternatives for this line"><svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></span>'
            : '';

        // Name cell. An option group with no product of its own falls back to
        // its line description ("Colour"); when a default option resolved it,
        // that part is named and marked as the default.
        var nameCell;
        if (l.partid) {
            nameCell = '<a class="fb-row-link" onclick="openModule(\'Part\',\'' +
                esc(String(l.partnum).replace(/'/g, "\\'")) + '\')">' + esc(l.partnum) + '</a>' +
                (l.isoptiongroup ? ' <span class="line-type" title="This line is an option group; the default choice is shown.">default</span>' : '');
        } else {
            nameCell = '<span style="color:var(--c-tertiary)">' + esc(l.linedesc || '(no product)') + '</span>' +
                ' <span class="line-type" title="This option group has no default choice, so nothing is consumed by default and the line cannot limit the kit.">option group</span>';
        }
        var descCell = l.partid
            ? esc(l.partdesc) + (inv ? '' : ' · <span class="noninv">non-inventory</span>')
            : '<span class="noninv">no product selected by default</span>';

        out += '<tr class="' + (isConstraint ? 'constraint ' : '') + (isOptional ? 'opt-row' : '') + '">' +
            '<td class="comp-part"><div>' + toggle + nameCell +
              '<div class="comp-desc">' + descCell + '</div></div></td>' +
            '<td><span class="line-type">' + esc(l.linetype) + '</span>' +
              (isOptional
                ? '<div class="comp-desc" title="Optional lines count toward Kits Available because the kit is configured with them. Leave them off the order and the Excl. Optional figure applies instead.">optional</div>'
                : '') + '</td>' +
            '<td class="num">' + qpkCell + '</td>' +
            '<td>' + esc(rowUom) + '</td>' +
            _availCells(a, inv) +
            '<td class="num">' + _ifCell({ partid: l.partid, parttype: l.parttype }, kitsCell) + '</td>' +
            '</tr>';

        alts.forEach(function (o) {
            var oa = _availMap[o.partid + '|' + lgId] || null;
            var oinv = (o.parttype === 10);
            var okits = (oinv && qpk > 0) ? fmtQty(Math.floor((oa ? oa.available : 0) / qpk)) : '—';
            out += '<tr class="alt-row alt-' + l.kititemid + '"' + (startOpen ? '' : ' style="display:none"') + '>' +
                '<td class="comp-part"><div style="padding-left:24px;font-weight:400">' +
                  '<span style="color:var(--c-tertiary)">↳ </span>' +
                  '<a class="fb-row-link" onclick="openModule(\'Part\',\'' +
                    esc(String(o.partnum).replace(/'/g, "\\'")) + '\')">' + esc(o.partnum) + '</a>' +
                  (o.isdefault ? ' <span class="line-type">default</span>' : '') +
                  '<div class="comp-desc">' + esc(o.partdesc) + '</div></div></td>' +
                '<td><span class="line-type">alternative</span></td>' +
                '<td class="num">' + (qpk > 0 ? fmtQty(qpk) : '—') + '</td>' +
                '<td>' + esc(o.partuom || '') + '</td>' +
                _availCells(oa, oinv) +
                '<td class="num">' + _ifCell(o, okits) + '</td>' +
                '</tr>';
        });
    });
    return out;
}
// Fold / unfold one line's alternatives. Scoped to the detail table the chevron
// lives in — several kits can be expanded at once, so there is no single
// breakdown tbody to look up by id any more.
function _toggleAlts(el, lineId) {
    var open = !el.classList.contains('open');
    el.classList.toggle('open', open);
    var tbl = el.closest('table.drill-tbl');
    if (!tbl) return;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(tbl.querySelectorAll('tr.alt-' + lineId), function (tr) {
        tr.style.display = open ? '' : 'none';
    });
}

// ============================================================================
//  EXPORT  (CSV + real .xlsx, both via FBLib.Export — see its block comment for
//  the JxBrowser download gotchas it centralises)
// ============================================================================
// The on-screen column set, in the user's current order, mapped to the shape
// FBLib.Export wants. Formatter-only columns export their raw value.
function _exportCols() {
    return _table.getColumns()
        .filter(function (c) { return c.vis !== false; })
        .map(function (c) {
            var t = c.money ? 'money' : (c.qty ? 'qty' : 'text');
            return { key: c.key, label: c.label, w: c.width, type: t,
                     // Kits Available et al are counts, not amounts to sum across
                     // unrelated kits — but a total is still meaningful per filter,
                     // so only the price (a RATE) is kept out.
                     noTotal: (c.key === 'kitprice') };
        });
}
function _fileStem() { return 'kit_availability_' + new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]; }

function exportCsv() {
    if (!_table || !_dataset.length) { debugLog('exportCsv: no data', 'warn'); return; }
    var rows = _table.getVisibleRows();
    FBLib.Export.csv({ filename: _fileStem(), cols: _exportCols(), rows: rows });
    debugLog('Exported ' + rows.length + ' rows to CSV', 'success');
}

async function exportXlsx() {
    if (!_table || !_dataset.length) { debugLog('exportXlsx: no data', 'warn'); return; }
    var rows = _table.getVisibleRows();
    var lgNames = selectedLgIds().map(lgNameById).join(', ');
    try {
        await FBLib.Export.xlsx({
            filename: _fileStem(),
            sheet: {
                name: 'Kit Availability',
                title: 'Kit Availability',
                subtitle: [
                    'Scope: ' + (_scopeMode === 'consolidated'
                        ? 'consolidated across the selected groups (raw summed, floored once — matches the Jasper report)'
                        : 'one row per location group'),
                    'Location group(s): ' + (lgNames || 'all accessible'),
                    'Basis: Available for Sale (on hand − allocated − not available + drop ship). ' +
                        'Kits Available counts every kit line at its default option choice (the kit as ' +
                        'configured); Excl. Optional drops the optional lines; Best Variation picks the ' +
                        'best-stocked option on each line.',
                    'Generated ' + new Date().toLocaleString()
                ],
                cols: _exportCols(),
                rows: rows,
                totals: true
            }
        });
        debugLog('Exported ' + rows.length + ' rows to Excel', 'success');
    } catch (e) {
        debugLog('exportXlsx failed: ' + (e && e.message), 'error');
    }
}

// ============================================================================
//  PRINT  (new-window workaround — window.print() is unreliable in JxBrowser)
// ============================================================================
function printReport() {
    if (!_table) return;
    var cols = _table.getColumns().filter(function (c) { return c.vis !== false; });
    var rows = _table.getVisibleRows();
    if (!rows.length) { debugLog('printReport: no rows', 'warn'); return; }
    function escHtml(s) { return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) { return ({ '&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":''' })[c]; }); }
    function cellText(col, row) {
        var raw = row[col.key];
        var out = (typeof col.format === 'function') ? col.format(raw, row) : raw;
        if (out == null) return '';
        var s = String(out).replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '');
        return s.replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/'/g, "'");
    }
    var title = 'Kit Availability';
    var basis = 'Kits Available = the kit as configured (every line, default option choice)';
    var hdr = cols.map(function (c) { return '<th>' + escHtml(c.label) + '</th>'; }).join('');
    var body = rows.map(function (r) {
        return '<tr>' + cols.map(function (c) {
            var t = escHtml(cellText(c, r));
            var cls = (c.align === 'right') ? ' class="nr"' : (c.align === 'center' ? ' class="nc"' : '');
            return '<td' + cls + '>' + t + '</td>';
        }).join('') + '</tr>';
    }).join('');
    var html = '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"/><title>' + escHtml(title) + '</title><style>' +
        'body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:8pt;margin:.4in;color:#111}' +
        'h2{font-size:11pt;margin:0 0 4px;color:#0B3140}.sub{font-size:7.5pt;color:#506872;margin:0 0 10px}' +
        'table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%}' +
        'th{background:#0B3140;color:#fff;font-size:7pt;padding:4px 5px;text-align:left;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}' +
        'td{font-size:7.5pt;padding:3px 5px;border-bottom:1px solid #E3E3E3}' +
        'tr:nth-child(even) td{background:#F7F7F7;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}' +
        '.nr{text-align:right}.nc{text-align:center}@page{size:A4 landscape;margin:.4in}' +
        '</style></head><body><h2>' + escHtml(title) + '</h2>' +
        '<p class="sub">' + rows.length.toLocaleString() + ' row' + (rows.length === 1 ? '' : 's') +
        ' — available for sale basis, ' + escHtml(basis) +
        ' — printed ' + new Date().toLocaleDateString() + '</p>' +
        '<table><thead><tr>' + hdr + '</tr></thead><tbody>' + body + '</tbody></table></body></html>';
    var w = window.open('', '_blank');
    if (!w) { debugLog('printReport: popup blocked', 'warn'); return; }
    w.document.write(html); w.document.close(); w.focus(); w.print();
    debugLog('Printed ' + rows.length + ' rows', 'success');
}

// ============================================================================
//  SETTINGS
// ============================================================================
function _hydrateSettings() {
    document.getElementById('setShowDebug').checked = !!_resolve('showDebug', false);
    document.getElementById('setRememberFilters').checked = !!_resolve('rememberFilters', true);
    _setAvailFilter(_resolve('availFilter', 'now'));
    _setScopeMode(_resolve('scopeMode', 'perlg'));
}
function onSettingsChange() {
    var showDebug = document.getElementById('setShowDebug').checked;
    _setUserKey('showDebug', showDebug);
    _setUserKey('rememberFilters', document.getElementById('setRememberFilters').checked);
    _applyDebugDrawer(showDebug);
}
function resetSettings() {
    if (!confirm('Reset your personal settings to defaults?')) return;
    try { FBLib.Settings.clearUser(); } catch (_) {}
    _hydrateSettings();
    _applyDebugDrawer(!!_resolve('showDebug', false));
    loadDashboard();
}
function publishDefaults() {
    if (!FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) return;
    if (!confirm('Publish current settings as the default for all users?')) return;
    try {
        FBLib.Settings.publishMaster({
            rememberFilters: document.getElementById('setRememberFilters').checked,
            availFilter: _availFilter,
            scopeMode: _scopeMode
        });
        debugLog('Defaults published', 'success');
    } catch (e) { debugLog('publishDefaults: ' + e.message, 'error'); }
}
function toggleUserEditing() {
    if (!FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) return;
    try { FBLib.Settings.setLock(FBLib.Settings.userEditingAllowed()); _refreshAdminUi(); }
    catch (e) { debugLog('toggleUserEditing: ' + e.message, 'error'); }
}
function _refreshAdminUi() {
    var isAdmin = FBLib.Settings.isAdmin();
    document.getElementById('dsAdminSection').style.display = isAdmin ? 'block' : 'none';
    var allowed = FBLib.Settings.userEditingAllowed();
    document.getElementById('dsLockBadge').style.display = (!allowed && !isAdmin) ? 'block' : 'none';
    var lockBtn = document.getElementById('dsLockBtn');
    if (lockBtn) lockBtn.textContent = allowed ? 'Lock user editing' : 'Unlock user editing';
}

// ============================================================================
//  DEBUG DRAWER
// ============================================================================
var _debugApi = null;
function _applyDebugDrawer(showIt) {
    if (!_debugApi) _debugApi = FBLib.Common.mountDebugDrawer();
    if (!_debugApi) return;
    if (showIt) { _debugApi.show(); _debugApi.expand(); } else _debugApi.hide();
    if (_debugApi.element) _observeDebugDrawer(_debugApi.element);
}
function _observeDebugDrawer(el) {
    if (!el || el._observed) return;
    el._observed = true;
    var apply = function () {
        var visible = el.classList.contains('is-visible'), open = el.classList.contains('is-open');
        var h = (visible && open) ? Math.ceil(el.getBoundingClientRect().height) : (visible ? 40 : 0);
        document.body.style.setProperty('--debug-drawer-h', h + 'px');
    };
    apply();
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') { try { new ResizeObserver(apply).observe(el); } catch (_) {} }
    try { new MutationObserver(apply).observe(el, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] }); } catch (_) {}
}

// ============================================================================
//  INIT
// ============================================================================
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async function () {
  try {
    // Register the drawers with fb-lib — mutual-exclusion, ESC-to-close,
    // trigger .active state, and the shared backdrop scrim are all handled by
    // fb-lib (no local scrim wiring; see the CSS note above).
    FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'filtersOverlay', triggerId: 'filtersBtn' });
    FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'setOverlay',     triggerId: 'setBtn'     });
    FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'helpOverlay',    triggerId: 'helpBtn'    });

    // Chips.
    document.querySelectorAll('#availChips input').forEach(function (inp) {
        inp.addEventListener('change', function () { onAvailFilterChange(inp.value); });
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('#scopeChips input').forEach(function (inp) {
        inp.addEventListener('change', function () { onScopeModeChange(inp.value); });
    });

    // Location Group drives the SQL, so re-run the query once per dropdown
    // session (onClose). Kit + Constraint are client-side filters over the
    // loaded rows, so they repaint live on each change (onChange).
    _lgMs = FBLib.Common.MultiSelect.create({
        containerId: 'lgMs',
        items: [],
        placeholder: 'All my location groups',
        onClose: function () { loadDashboard(); }
    });
    _kitMs = FBLib.Common.MultiSelect.create({
        containerId: 'kitMs',
        items: [],
        placeholder: 'All kits',
        onChange: function () { _refreshTable(); }
    });
    _constraintMs = FBLib.Common.MultiSelect.create({
        containerId: 'constraintMs',
        items: [],
        placeholder: 'All constraint parts',
        onChange: function () { _refreshTable(); }
    });

    // FBLib.Table: sort / drag-reorder / drag-resize / lazy render + persisted
    // layout (settingsKey). getRows returns the client-filtered set.
    _table = FBLib.Table.init({
        tableEl: document.getElementById('reportTable'),
        columns: _columns,
        getRows: function () { return _dataset; },
        chunkSize: 200,
        settingsKey: 'tablePrefs'
    });

    // Inline expansion. One delegated click handler covers every row (including
    // rows the lazy renderer has not painted yet), and the observer re-applies
    // the open panels after the table sorts, filters or appends a chunk.
    var tb = document.querySelector('#reportTable tbody');
    tb.addEventListener('click', _onTbodyClick);
    if (typeof MutationObserver === 'function') {
        _rowObserver = new MutationObserver(function () { _syncDetails(); });
        _rowObserver.observe(tb, { childList: true });
    }

    _hydrateSettings();
    _applyDebugDrawer(!!_resolve('showDebug', false));
    _refreshAdminUi();

    document.getElementById('filterKit').addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') loadDashboard(); });
    document.getElementById('filterActiveOnly').addEventListener('change', loadDashboard);

    await loadFilters();
    await loadDashboard();
    debugLog('Report initialised', 'success');
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[KitAvailability init] failed:', e);
    var sl = document.getElementById('statusLine');
    if (sl) sl.textContent = 'Init failed — ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : 'see browser console');
    try { FBLib.Common.debugLog('Init failed: ' + (e && e.stack ? e.stack : e), 'error'); } catch (_) {}
  }
});

// Inline-handler exports.
window.loadDashboard     = loadDashboard;
window.clearFilters      = clearFilters;
window.exportCsv         = exportCsv;
window.exportXlsx        = exportXlsx;
window.printReport       = printReport;
window.onSettingsChange  = onSettingsChange;
window.resetSettings     = resetSettings;
window.publishDefaults   = publishDefaults;
window.toggleUserEditing = toggleUserEditing;
window.toggleExpandAll   = toggleExpandAll;
window.onScopeModeChange = onScopeModeChange;
window._toggleAlts       = _toggleAlts;
</script>
